findings.description: Gmail, Yahoo Mail, and some other providers strip <style> tags containing media queries. The 600px fixed-width table layout serves as fallback, but mobile users on these clients won't get optimized layouts.
findings.action: Document this limitation in SETUP.md or add a note in the templates themselves.

findings.description: All social media links use href='#' placeholders. Before production, replace with actual CineGen social profiles or remove unused links to avoid dead clicks in real emails.
findings.action: Replace placeholder social links with real URLs or remove before production deployment.

findings.issue: Match score badge uses flexbox in nested div
findings.description: The circular badge in brief-match.html uses nested tables for Outlook compatibility, but the inner div uses display:flex which Outlook doesn't support. The fallback renders acceptably, but centering may be imperfect.
findings.action: Consider using table-based vertical centering (vertical-align: middle) instead of flexbox for perfect cross-client compatibility.

summary: All 6 email templates exist with proper inline CSS, table-based layouts, CineGen branding (dark theme with violet/cyan gradients), DEMO watermarks, mobile media queries, complete footers, prominent OTP and CTA styling. TypeScript implementation is type-safe with XSS protection. Test endpoint renders all templates successfully. Minor issues are documentation and placeholder links that should be addressed before production, but do not block approval.
